summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing termination of its non-binding letter of intent to acquire AI Financial Corporation's subsidiary, Alt5 Sigma Canada, Inc. No financial terms, premium, or consideration were disclosed in the letter of intent or the termination filing. The company issued a press release stating it decided not to further pursue the acquisition. Board recommendation and advisors are not mentioned. This is a termination without a definitive agreement, so no break fee applies. The risk-arb angle is moot since the deal never reached a definitive stage; the watch item is whether Perpetuals.com pursues alternative M&A targets.
